text: Ahh, another one who wants to join the transport to the academy?
zh: 啊，又来一个想搭车去魔法学院的？

text: We'll wait here for the others for a while.
zh: 我们要在这儿等其他人一会儿。

text: Yes, I'd like to travel to the academy.
Nope, I have to go somewhere else.
zh: 不了，我还有别的地方要去。

text: If you happen to change your mind, we may be still here and can take you with us.
zh: 要是你改变主意了，我们没准还在这儿，可以捎上你。

text: Very good. The fee for safe transportation through the Marin Passage is 100 gold coins.
zh: 很好。安全穿越马林通道的护送费是100金币。

text: Here are the 100 gold coins for the transport.
Why do you charge so much for the transport?
zh: 护送费为什么收这么贵？

text:
The number of raiders in the Marin Passage continues to rise.
They attack all travelers who are unescorted or not prepared.
zh:
马林通道里的掠夺者越来越多了。
凡是没有护卫或毫无防备的旅人，都会遭到他们袭击。

text: And we, the royal guard, will take care of them if they attack you in the passage.
zh: 而我们皇家卫队会在通道里替你解决来袭的掠夺者。

text:
All good!
So we've cleared everything up.
zh:
好了！
这样一切都谈妥了。

text: We'll wait a bit longer and then begin the journey to the academy.
zh: 我们再等一小会儿，就动身前往学院。

text:
I see.
Then we don't have to wait for you any longer.
zh:
明白了。
那我们就不用再等你了。

text: Reach out to Edmon, the king's advisor, to find out when the next transport through the passage will take place.
zh: 想知道下一趟穿越通道的护送队什么时候出发，去问国王的顾问埃德蒙吧。

text:
Oh, it's you again!
Do you want to join the trip to the academy?
zh:
哦，又是你！
想加入去学院的这一趟吗？

text: My name is Travis and I will accompany you to the academy today.
zh: 我叫特拉维斯，今天由我护送你前往学院。
